question: Karan starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards the North. He then takes a right turn, drives 6 km, then turns right and drives 16 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 8 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km, and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Karan starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards the North.

He then takes a right turn, drives 6 km, then turns right and drives 16 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 8 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km, and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a29b71ced5cf6dfcab5790fe99ab8323483e42f601fccf2e76df843b3cd457f7.png] 

So,He should drive **2 km to the east** in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
